in_hebrew.name: Tome
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tome הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word ‘tomus’, meaning ‘book’ or ‘scroll’. This name was given to individuals who were scribes or scholars in the Roman Empire. In Christianity, it is also used as a name for the early Christian writings, such as the New Testament.
